candidates.title: SPECTRE: Hybrid Ordinary-Parallel Speculative Serving for Resource-Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Serving-level speculative execution that reuses underutilized tenant models as remote drafters; strong systems relevance and an SGLang implementation.
evidence: Implements hybrid ordinary-parallel speculative serving in SGLang
Reports up to 2.28x speedup over autoregressive decoding and up to 66% relative gain over speculative baselines
